column1: # Ini names: the map from the code's internal (module, key) to the public [section] key of dazdrive.ini.
# Source of core/ini_names.inc (tools/gen_ini_names.py). Columns: module (internal), old_key (internal and legacy name), section, key,
# audience (user|advanced|internal), type (number|switch|choice), choices (value=word ...; choice rows only).
# internal keys are not written into a generated ini, but are read when a player adds them (new name or old name).
